title: rest: GET /data/OBJ/export silently answers an unknown format (pdf, xml, empty) with a 200 CSV instead of refusing it
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSwDXZrZg7nGjP6P3U

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a reproduction, found by an off-clause probe of QA run #27438 (wave 3 of the 18.3.0 sweep, anchor #27377). It was reproduced with 3 spellings. reach: measured at the public export door.
Business reason: an integration or script that asks for `format=pdf`, `xml` or a typo gets a 200 with a CSV attachment and no signal that the request was not honoured. Downstream code that branches on the status, or saves the file under the requested extension, silently mishandles it. The other format-bearing doors refuse unknown values.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then the implementer for `packages/rest` (`src/data-action-routes.ts`, the export route).
Dedupe (open AND closed): the query "export unknown format pdf returns csv 200 instead of 400" returned 0 hits.

Batch-of: 16 · QA run #27438

## Symptom

`GET /data/OBJ/export` silently coerces an unknown or empty `format` to CSV instead of refusing it.

## Reproduction (subject c4c515ad, stock showcase)

1. As a caller holding the export grant, `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task/export?format=pdf` → **200**, `text/csv`, a `.csv` attachment, `X-Export-Format: csv`.
2. The same happens with `format=xml` and with `format=` (empty).
3. The supported values `csv`, `xlsx` and `json` each answer their own format.

**Expected:** an unknown `format` answers 400, naming the value and the supported set. An absent `format` may still default to CSV.

## Mechanism

`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts` lines 1074–1076 map any value other than `json` or `xlsx` to CSV.
